/* ===== Bloco de metadados ===== */
.meta-info {
  text-align: center;
  color: #cfe0d5;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  margin: 0.5rem 0 2.5rem 0;

}
.meta-info strong {
  color: #d9b054;
}
.meta-divider {
  width: 60px;
  height: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #b8862a, transparent);
  margin: 1.5rem auto;

/* ===== Timeline horizontal, ocupando a largura da página ===== */
.timeline {
  width: 100%;
  margin: 2rem 0 0 0;
  position: relative;
  padding: 2.6rem 2rem 0 2rem;
  display: flex;
  gap: 1.5rem;
}
.timeline::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: calc(2rem + 26px);
  right: calc(2rem + 26px);
  top: 2.6rem;
  height: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #3f6b52, #b8862a, #3f6b52);
  opacity: 0.5;
}

.tl-item {
  position: relative;
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  text-align: center;
  gap: 0.9rem;
  padding: 1.6rem 1.3rem 1.3rem 1.3rem;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: rgba(20, 38, 30, 0.55);
  border: 1px solid rgba(184, 134, 42, 0.25);
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
}
.tl-item:hover {
  transform: translateY(-6px);
  border-color: rgba(184, 134, 42, 0.6);
}

.tl-icon {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: 52px;
  height: 52px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, #1c2b23 0%, #10241d 100%);
  border: 2px solid #b8862a;
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(184, 134, 42, 0.35);
  z-index: 1;
}

.tl-body {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
}
.tl-tag {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #10241d;
  background: #b8862a;
  padding: 2px 10px;
  border-radius: 99px;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.tl-title {
  color: #e8f0ea;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin: 0 0 2px 0;
}
.tl-desc {
  color: #9fb3a7;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.7rem;
}
.tl-body .btn {
  background: transparent;
  border: 1.5px solid #3f6b52;
  color: #cfe0d5;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  padding: 4px 14px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}
.tl-body .btn:hover {
  background: #3f6b52;
  color: #ffffff;
  border-color: #3f6b52;
}

/* Estado "em breve" */
.tl-item.tl-pending {
  opacity: 0.6;
}
.tl-item.tl-pending .tl-icon {
  border-color: #6b7d73;
  box-shadow: none;
}

}
